title: New corridor talks to open after Orvan request

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: New talks on an Orvan grain corridor will open at the request of exporters.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry says new talks on an Orvan grain corridor will open at the request of exporters.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: The talks will cover sea movements and rail capacity.

source_ref.text_snippet: The talks will cover sea movements and rail capacity, the ministry says.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: No terms have been agreed and no date has been set for a conclusion.

source_ref.text_snippet: No terms have been agreed and no date has been set for a conclusion.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: Current rules remain in force until a new text is agreed.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry says current rules remain in force until a new text is agreed.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: Current export rules remain in force.

source_ref.text_snippet: Current export rules remain in force.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: Exporters have been told to keep their existing bookings.

source_ref.text_snippet: Exporters have been told to keep their existing bookings.

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: The notice is shorter than the one that preceded the original agreement.

source_ref.text_snippet: The notice is shorter than the one that preceded the original agreement.
